description: Look up one player account on the platform itself: a Minecraft Java username, a Steam SteamID64, an Xbox gamertag, or a Hytale identifier. Returns the account's id, username, avatar and any platform metadata. This searches the platform's own player directory, not the server: it cannot tell you whether that player has joined, is whitelisted, or is banned. Use list_online_players for who is on the server right now. An instance is required only to authorize the lookup. The match is exact, so a partial or misspelled identifier reports no match.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name. Used only to authorize the lookup; it does not scope the search.

platform.description: Which platform to look the player up on.

query.description: The player identifier to look up. Format depends on platform: a Java username, a SteamID64, an Xbox gamertag, or a Hytale identifier.

name: search_player
title: Search Player
